JiwaDocument.Name: Hero Items
JiwaDocument.Description:
This plugin adds a tab to sales orders called "Hero Items". On this tab is a series of panels, each panel representing a category 1 entry (i.e. Clothing, Computer, Door, etc.). Within each panel are indicators representing inventory items that have their custom field "Hero Item" ticked (this plugin also creates this custom field).

An indicator has a picture of the inventory item, the quantity that are on this order, and a plus and minus button that can be clicked to increase of decrease the quantity of that item on the order.
JiwaDocument.Author: Jiwa Financials

CustomField.Name: Hero Item
CustomField.Description: Denotes whether this item will appear on the "Hero Items" tab of sales orders for quick order entry.
